nonBehavioral: GH_TELEMETRY=0 only stops gh writing its own telemetry device-id under HOME; gh stdout, stderr and exit codes are byte-identical with and without it (checked with gh 2.103.0: auth status and --version), so no model-visible input changes. The one verdict it touches is a HOME stray-write detector counting gh's own state file, which gh releases before 2.103 never wrote.
